properties.name: Kraken Traveller 2E Syrinscape
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: Kraken-branded Syrinscape automation for the Traveller 2E Fantasy Grounds ruleset. 91 sci-fi sounds and 143 triggers across 7 toggleable categories: personal weapons, ship combat, damage impacts, wounds/status, skill rolls, task results, and communications. Every setting is in Options > Kraken Syrinscape (or /krakensyrin config for the category toggles). Type /krakensyrin help for all commands.
